name: Cortante - [MMMM]
description: Here is a tip for you to scrawl, please underline it twice: the blood belongs inside the body. When you find a bleed, it is your responsibility to stop it as quickly as possible. Do not rely on magical healing to fix the issue, use pressure and tight bandages. Use of leeches not recommended; you want more blood inside the body, not less.

results.description:
The attack has hit one of your vital points and opened a large artery. You are bleeding out. At the end of each turn, take one level of &Reference[exhaustion]{exhaustion} .

Tratamento - A [[/skill medicine 16]] check staunches bleeding. On a failed Teste de Resistência you do not take a level of exhaustion at the end of your next turn. You may reattempt this check.
results.name: Exsanguinating

results.description:
You see blood pour from your wound and you feel a bit light headed. At the end of each turn you take Dano to your maximum Hit Points scaled to the Dano that caused the Lesão Persistente: 1-10 Dano ( [[1d4]] ), 11-20 Dano ( [[1d6]] ), 21-30 Dano ( [[1d8]] ), 31-40 Dano ( [[1d10]] ), > 40 Dano ( [[1d12]] ).

Tratamento - A [[/skill medicine 11]] check staunches the bleeding. You may reattempt this check.
results.name: Hemorrhaging

results.description:
Você vê sangue escorrendo da sua ferida. Não é muito, mas faz sentido. No final de cada turno, você sofre dano ao máximo de pontos de vida dimensionados para o dano que causou a lesão persistente: 1-10 dano ( [[1d2]] ), 11-20 dano ( [[1d4]] ), 21-30 dano ( [[1d6]] ), 31-40 dano ( __ X4X __ ), __ X5X __ 40 dano ( [[1d10]] ).

Tratamento - Uma verificação __X11X __ estanca o sangramento. Você pode tentar novamente esta verificação.

results.description:
Your wound looks angry near its edges and stubbornly refuses to heal. Você não pode heal Hit Points through não mágico means (such as short or Long Rests).

Tratamento - Once per Long Rest you may make a [[/skill medicine 18]] check to heal this injury.
results.name: Supurante Ferida

results.description:

Tratamento - A [[/skill medicine 15]] check reduces the duration of this injury by [[1d6]] days.
